title: Privileged Access Containment and Forensic Audit Playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Create an operational playbook and implementation tasks to contain compromised admin sessions, enrich audit trails for post-incident forensics, and close gaps found in the recent SSO/SAML pen-test. Deliverables include a runbook for live containment, schema and retention changes to audit logs, detection/enrichment pipelines, mitigation PRs, and a staged rollout for RBAC v2 role changes. Scope includes admin consoles, token issuance/refresh flows, session revocation, SAML assertion validation telemetry, and the admin audit pipeline (ingest -> enrichment -> storage). Out of scope: application-level user permissions beyond privileged console/admin surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook exists with step-by-step containment instructions and has been validated in tabletop exercise
Audit events include immutable session_id, assertion_id, issuer_fingerprint, and admin_action_category
SAML assertion validation failures and anomalous token refreshes are surfaced to PagerDuty with triage playbooks
Automated revoke endpoint tested end-to-end for active sessions (simulated attacker session)
Relevant PRs reviewed and merged, and rollout completed to 75% of production hosts without service-impacting incidents
tasks: Threat model update focusing on admin attack paths and assertion replay scenarios
Design audit schema changes and retention policy (append-only index with 1y cold storage)
Implement session revocation API that invalidates cached KV lookups and forces token rotation
Add SAML assertion fingerprinting and include fingerprint on every admin action event
Wire telemetry into enrichment pipeline: add fields, blackbox test events, and validate stored events in Splunk/Datadog
Pen-test follow-up fixes: address 3rd-party SAML library validation flags and tighten assertion lifetime checks
Create tabletop exercise playbook and schedule with on-call, infra, and security
E2E tests for revoke + session-expiry behavior and CI gate enforcement
mitigation_steps: Immediate: Add temporary rule to deny new admin sessions from suspicious IP ranges reported by pen-test
Immediate: Increase audit-level verbosity for admin endpoints (token_issued, token_refreshed, token_revoked)
Short term: Deploy revocation endpoint behind authz enforcing admin-only scope
Medium term: Migrate admin roles to least-privileged naming and remove broad wildcard roles
Long term: Instrument continuous monitoring for assertion reuse and implement automatic session quarantine policy
rollout_plan: Canary: Deploy audit schema and enrichment consumer to staging and 2% of prod traffic for 48h
Validation: Run synthetic admin flows and replay test assertion events through the pipeline
Broad rollout: Increment to 50% with monitoring for error rates and ingestion latency
Cutover: Enable revocation endpoint and enforcement, then migrate admin role mappings (feature flag-controlled)
Post rollout: Run a full retention and query performance sanity check and update runbook accordingly
qa_plan: Unit tests for new audit fields and assertion fingerprint logic
Integration tests simulating SAML assertion replay and token refresh abuse cases
Chaos test: Simulate datastore latency while revoking sessions to ensure safe failure modes
Tabletop exercise: simulate compromised admin account and follow runbook end-to-end
